tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Shows the Cruma account this connection is signed in as (account id, name, email), the organizations it belongs to, and the one this connection acts in.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the Cruma services available on this account, and whether each is answering. Use describe_service to learn what one does and which tools it has.

tools.name: describe_service
tools.description: Describes one service from list_services: what it does, and its tools with the scope each needs and whether it asks for confirmation. The service's tools are listed from then on.

service.description: The service's key, as list_services names it.

tools.name: select_organization
tools.description: Makes this connection act in one of the organizations whoami lists, instead of the personal one. The services and tools available can differ per organization.

organization.description: The organization's id, as whoami lists it.

tools.name: session_context
tools.description: Returns the user's note for coding agents: which Cruma boards and memory spaces to use and whether agents may change them. Empty when the user has turned both off. Clients without a session-start hook (e.g. Codex) call this once at the start of a session.

tools.name: get_coding_agent_settings
tools.description: Shows the user's coding-agent settings: whether agents use the Cruma board and memory, the enabled boards and memory spaces with their defaults, and whether agents may write to them.

tools.name: update_coding_agent_settings
tools.description: Changes the user's coding-agent settings, the same ones as on their Cruma account page. Only the fields given change. Turning the board or memory on reveals its service in list_services; `agents_may_write` lets agents change the board and write memory. Change these only when the user asks to.

board_enabled.description: Coding agents use the Cruma board.

agents_may_write.description: Coding agents may change the board and write memory. Grant it only when the user asks to.

id.description: The board's or memory space's id.

boards.description: The enabled boards, in order. Replaces the whole list.

id.description: The board's or memory space's id.

spaces.description: The enabled memory spaces, in order. Replaces the whole list.

default_board_id.description: The default board: one of the enabled boards' ids, or null for none.

default_space_id.description: The default memory space: one of the enabled spaces' ids, or null for none.

tools.name: core-board_guide
tools.description: Returns the guide for using the Cruma board from a coding agent. Read it before any other board tool.

tools.name: core-board_list_boards
tools.description: Lists the boards the user belongs to, with their ids and names.

tools.name: core-board_create_task
tools.description: Creates a task on a board.

tools.name: memgraph-spaces_list
tools.description: Lists the memory spaces the user can read, with their ids and names.

tools.name: memgraph-memory_recall
tools.description: Recalls memories relevant to a query from one memory space.

tools.name: memgraph-memory_create
tools.description: Writes one memory into a memory space.
